title: Open-Ended Architectural Design Services for RCCC
short_description: On-call architectural and engineering services for small miscellaneous college projects.
project_scope: Open-ended, on-call design services for Rowan-Cabarrus Community College for small miscellaneous projects on a routine or as-needed basis. The notice indicates rehabilitation and refurbishment as part of the scope. Total construction cost stated as 150,000 USD, but no individual building sizes, structural spans, or gross floor areas are provided.
services: Architectural design services; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering; construction/project management; electrical engineering; mechanical engineering; structural engineering. Up to three renewable contracts may be awarded with a 12-month base period and one 12-month renewal option.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an open-ended on-call architectural services contract for small miscellaneous projects.
- Framework-style arrangement without a defined technically demanding structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but no specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or complex special structure is identified.
- Total construction cost is very small, indicating limited structural scope.
- Also includes disciplines outside sbp's core focus such as MEP and project management.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. Only a total construction cost of 150,000 USD is stated for small miscellaneous projects under an open-ended, on-call contract, which is insufficient to derive a reliable sbp fee.
references_qualifications: No specific bidder reference requirements or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text. Requested disciplines include architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
